definitions.gloss: indefinite; with no time limit; open-ended
definitions.explanation: Having no set end date or deadline. Used for strikes, suspensions, postponements, loans and the like.

examples.japanese: {無期限|むきげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{無期限|むきげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ストライキ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{割引券|わりびきけん}→割引券：09545_waribikiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無期限|むきげん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ことができる→ことができる：32887_kotogadekiru⟧。
examples.english: This discount coupon has no expiry date, so you can use it any time.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無期限|むきげん}⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: indefinite postponement
- {無期限|むきげん}⟦{休止|きゅうし}→休止：17081_kyuushi⟧: indefinite hiatus (of a band, a service)
- {無期限|むきげん}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: suspension until further notice
- {無期限|むきげん}スト: open-ended strike
- {無期限|むきげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧: to lend with no return date

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無期|むき}→無期：33725_muki⟧: the same idea, but mostly in fixed legal terms (⟦{無期|むき}{懲役|ちょうえき}→無期懲役：22698_mukichoueki⟧, life imprisonment); {無期限|むきげん} is the everyday word
- ⟦{無制限|むせいげん}→無制限：17829_museigen⟧: with no limit of any kind (amount, number), not only of time
